links.effect: Baseline GPT-5 prompt achieved F1 score 0.48 and sensitivity 0.37 on the validation set.
links.quote: The baseline GPT-5 prompt achieved an F1 score of 0.48 and sensitivity of 0.37 on the validation set.

links.effect: Automated prompt optimization improved F1/sensitivity but reduced PPV/specificity; test-time scaling and expert prompt engineering showed minimal improvement.
links.quote: Automated prompt optimization had higher F1 score and sensitivity than the basic prompt on the hold-out test set, with lower PPV and specificity; test-time scaling and expert-led prompt engineering showed minimal improvement.

links.effect: Operational workflows were the majority of LLM errors, rather than medical knowledge alone.
links.quote: Operational workflows, rather than medical knowledge alone, represented the majority of LLM errors.
